scope: Exact published location codes and explicit package wording; no benchmark answers, source-route inference, package classification, native ECUS catalog compatibility guarantee or phone numbering-plan claim.

sources.supports: UN/LOCODE consists of the country element plus three-character location element. Airport is function 4. The IATA column is empty when the location element itself matches its IATA code. The helper accepts a country/location routing prefix only when both tokens match the same verified row; it does not identify the suffix.

Package, Packages, PKG and PKGS are spelling/abbreviation forms of explicit package wording, represented as PK only in packageUnit. Piece/PCS/PCE are not package synonyms; Piece has a separate packaging meaning and code PP, so bare piece counts remain unresolved. Goods quantity pieces still use the separately documented PCE representation.

retrieval: Verified against primary-source public search results. Direct opens of the static UNECE country pages returned HTTP 403; no downloaded source-file hash or complete current-directory audit is asserted.

phoneRule.supports: No number-plan repair from appearance alone. A +840... source value can be projected to +84... only when a separate current document explicitly quotes the otherwise identical +84... number for the same named party, all relevant clear source values agree under that single correction, and no conflicting party identifier exists. This is source corroboration, not a claim that every +840 number is invalid. The international representation is retained; no domestic prefix or area code is invented.
